title: Canada Labour Code
verified_how: Fetched the index page: title 'Canada Labour Code', citation (R.S.C., 1985, c. L-2), current to 2026-07-21, last amended 2025-12-12.
notes: Part III (Standard Hours, Wages, Vacations and Holidays) covers only federally regulated employment: banks, interprovincial transport, telecoms, federal Crown corporations and similar. Most employees are covered by provincial employment standards Acts instead.
